text:
Review complete — I read every source file, the tests, the config, and the committed demo outputs. Here's the honest picture.

## Overall assessment

The code craftsmanship is genuinely good: clean module boundaries, type hints throughout, deterministic seeding, careful manifest bookkeeping, sensible numerics (QR-based projection, epsilon-guarded norms). If this were judged on style alone it would score high. But two structural problems drag it down:

**1. The repo doesn't run as shipped.** `load_stories` (emovec/data.py:29) requires `data/stories/<emotion>/<NN>_<N>.txt` plus a `manifest.json`, and that directory doesn't exist anywhere in the repo. There's also no story-generation code, even though the README says stories are "loaded or generated." The committed `outputs/tiny_demo/` artifacts prove the data existed on the author's machine and was never committed. Consequence: `make demo`, all three CLI commands, and `tests/test_integration_tiny.py` all fail with `FileNotFoundError` on a fresh checkout. The test suite passing is an illusion — it can't have passed here.

**2. The tiny-mode "validation" is circular.** `TinyResidualBackend` injects the emotion signal from the label hint and a hand-built lexicon (emovec/model.py:144-153), and its `preference_logit` computes steering shifts directly from a hard-coded `EMOTION_VALENCE × category_valence` formula (lines 183-191). So the tiny demo's headline results — `diagonal_gt_off_diagonal: true`, Elo shifts in the "right" direction — are true by construction, and the integration test asserts that scientific conclusion against the mock. It's a fine test double for plumbing; it's misleading as a "validation" the README and summary.json present it as.

The HF (real-model) path has a few latent bugs that were likely never exercised: single-token assumptions for `" good"`/`" bad"`, and a silent fallback that steers *every* token when activity-span lookup fails.

## Concrete issues

| # | Location | Sev | Issue |
|---|----------|-----|-------|
| 1 | emovec/data.py:24-36 | high | Required `data/stories/` corpus is absent and no generator exists; extract/demo/integration test all crash |
| 2 | tests/test_integration_tiny.py:12-28 | high | End-to-end test cannot pass on a fresh clone (depends on uncommitted data) |
| 3 | emovec/model.py:144-153, 175-192 | medium | Tiny backend bakes expected outcomes into the mock; tiny-mode validation results are tautological |
| 4 | tests/test_integration_tiny.py:18 | medium | Asserts the scientific conclusion (`diagonal_gt_off_diagonal is True`) against the mock — tests the stub, not the method |
| 5 | emovec/model.py:306-308 | medium | Assumes `" good"`/`" bad"` are single tokens; silently uses only the first piece otherwise, corrupting the preference logit |
| 6 | emovec/model.py:239-240 | medium | If offset mapping can't locate the activity span (or tokenizer is slow), it silently steers all prompt tokens |
| 7 | README.md:11 | medium | Documents "load or generate" stories and runnable demo/tests; neither is true of the committed repo |
| 8 | emovec/model.py:264-268, 306-308 | low | Prompt asks for "a preference score" but the metric reads `" good"` vs `" bad"` continuation logits — measured tokens don't match the prompt |
| 9 | emovec/validate_contexts.py:66 | low | Falls back to emotion index 0 when "afraid" is missing yet still writes `afraid_dosage.*`, mislabeling output |
| 10 | emovec/steer_prefs.py:45-49 | low | If <4 emotions selected by correlation, the whole selection is discarded for `emotions[:4]` instead of topping up |
| 11 | emovec/extract.py:34-36 | low | Effective-start logic duplicated from `layer_position_mean`; manifest values can drift from what's actually used |
| 12 | config.yaml:10,50 | low | `data.neutral_corpus` and `steering.min_reported_emotions` are never read — dead config |
| 13 | emovec/vector_ops.py:31 | low | `threshold=0` still returns 1 PC (boundary off-by-one in `searchsorted`+1) |
| 14 | emovec/model.py:7 | low | Unused import `Iterable` |
| 15 | emovec/model.py:135-142 | low | `_token_vector` re-derives a SHA-256-seeded RNG and scans the whole lexicon per token occurrence, uncached |
| 16 | emovec/elo.py:19 | low | Magic temperature `20.0` in the logit→probability mapping, undocumented |
| 17 | outputs/tiny_demo/* | low | Generated artifacts (.npy/.png/.csv) committed to the repo |

## Lines needing rewrite/significant change

The source is roughly 1,000 lines. The fix is mostly *additive* (a story corpus or generator module, ~100-150 lines) plus targeted changes: HF `preference_logit` token handling and fallback behavior (~30), README corrections (~15), validate/steer fallback logic (~15), test restructuring so plumbing tests don't assert mock-derived science (~20). Call it **~180 lines**.

## Bottom line

**No, I would not approve this as-is.** Not because the code is sloppy — it isn't — but because the PR is incomplete: it ships a pipeline that cannot execute, a test suite that cannot pass, and a README that claims both work. Fix the missing data/generator, harden the two HF-path bugs, and reframe what tiny mode actually demonstrates, and this becomes an approvable, genuinely tidy little package.
